provenance.mask_policy: Preserve Phase 5A/Phase 8 cell identifiers and soil_water_valid mask; masked values are unavailable.

reference.sample_size: 20 same-calendar-month observations per cell when valid
reference.low_moisture_definition: Observed storage <= same-cell, same-calendar-month 20th percentile of 2006–2025 reference; a descriptive relative threshold, not an agronomic drought threshold.
reference.historical_low_moisture_frequency: count and frequency are calculated within the 20-year reference sample; threshold and frequency are descriptive and not independent evidence.

latest_observed_context.anomaly_definition: observed value minus same-cell, same-calendar-month 2006–2025 mean

en.below_reference_p20: Observed storage is below the cell's historical same-month 20th percentile.
en.within_reference_p20_p80: Observed storage is within the cell's historical same-month 20th–80th percentile range.
en.above_reference_p80: Observed storage is above the cell's historical same-month 80th percentile.

es.below_reference_p20: El almacenamiento observado está por debajo del percentil 20 histórico del mismo mes para esta celda.
es.within_reference_p20_p80: El almacenamiento observado está dentro del rango histórico de percentiles 20–80 del mismo mes para esta celda.
es.above_reference_p80: El almacenamiento observado está por encima del percentil 80 histórico del mismo mes para esta celda.

forecast_interpretation.en: The central outlook equals the historical seasonal normal; this does not establish that future conditions will be normal.
forecast_interpretation.es: La perspectiva central coincide con la normal estacional histórica; esto no demuestra que las condiciones futuras serán normales.
forecast_interpretation.probability_reason: Retrospective residuals and intervals do not establish calibrated event probabilities at this horizon and cell; no probability is inferred from the 90% interval.

probability_summary.reason: Available evidence does not validate calibrated probabilities of crossing the cell-specific historical p20 event threshold. A 90% prediction interval is not a predictive distribution; converting interval overlap to probability is invalid without validated distributional assumptions and event calibration.

agricultural_interpretation.scope: Hydrological context only; not crop-specific advice.
agricultural_interpretation.en: Describe observed soil-water storage relative to its local GLDAS seasonal history. Confirm field conditions before decisions.
agricultural_interpretation.es: Describa el almacenamiento de agua del suelo observado respecto de su historial estacional GLDAS local. Verifique las condiciones del lote antes de decidir.

methodology: Reference statistics use only 2006–2025 observations; later records do not change the reference.
Observed anomalies compare observations with the corresponding cell and calendar-month reference mean.
Forecast central anomalies are reported separately and are zero because the selected forecast is seasonal climatology.
Forecast anomalies are not claims that future anomalies will be zero.
limitations: GLDAS is modeled 0.25-degree grid data, not field measurement.
Historical percentiles describe this reference period and are not validated drought or crop thresholds.
Historical anomaly is descriptive, not causal.
Climatology is a baseline outlook, not demonstrated dynamic forecast skill.
No future low-moisture probability is supplied because event probabilities are not defensibly calibrated.
